title: Absolute K-flat derived comparison for concrete tensor pullback
statement: Let $g:X\to Y$ be a morphism of ringed spaces [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], whose module categories admit derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $P$ be an additive functor on modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with object and morphism formulas $O_X\otimes_{g^{-1}O_Y}g^{-1}(-)$ [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image]. Then there exist $L:D(O_Y)\to D(O_X)$ and $\epsilon:Q_Y L\to P^h Q_X$ which form a total left derived functor, with $\epsilon$ invertible on K-flat complexes [def-pc-kflat-complex]. For every $H:D(O_X)\to D(O_Y)$, the whiskered comparison exhibits $LH$ as the left derived functor of $P^hQ_XH$.

proof.text: Apply exists_tensorPullback_leftDerived to g, P and the object and morphism formulas. Obtain L and epsilon, the total left derived universal property and invertibility of epsilon on K-flat complexes.

Apply leftDerived_tensorPullback_absolute to the same data and the obtained universal property and K-flat comparison. Package its postcomposition conclusion with L, epsilon and the first two properties.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_absolute_leftDerived_tensorModulePullback
    {X Y : RingedSpace.{u}}
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y))]
    (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (P : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))
    (h : ∀ M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y),
      P.obj M = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u}
        (CochainComplex.tensorPullbackRingMap g.hom.base X.sheaf Y.sheaf ⟨g.hom.c⟩)
        (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule g.hom.base Y.sheaf M))
    (hm : ∀ {M N : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y)} (a : M ⟶ N),
      P.map a = eqToHom (h M) ≫ SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom.{u, u, u}
        (CochainComplex.tensorPullbackRingMap g.hom.base X.sheaf Y.sheaf ⟨g.hom.c⟩)
        (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule g.hom.base Y.sheaf M)
        (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModuleMap g.hom.base Y.sheaf M a) ≫
        eqToHom (h N).symm)
    [P.Additive] :
    ∃ (L : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y)) ⥤
        DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)))
      (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L ⟶
        P.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh),
      L.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε
        (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ∧
      (∀ K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y)) ℤ,
        K.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat → IsIso
          (ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K))) ∧
      ∀ H : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) ⥤
          DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y)),
        (L ⋙ H).IsLeftDerivedFunctor
          ((Functor.associator _ _ _).inv ≫ Functor.whiskerRight ε H)
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y))
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
